about.text: Defendant-Appellant David Rivera appeals the district court’s grant of summary judgment and subsequent final judgment in favor of the Federal Election Commission (FEC), finding him liable for violating the Federal Election Campaign Act (FECA), 52 U.S.C. § 30122.
